findings.title: Untested user_type pass-through in reconcile call
findings.problem: authenticate_persistent_user threads security_user_ins.user_type into reconcile_personal_project_on_email_change (lines 583-585), but the sole existing test for this call site (TestAuthenticatePersistentUser) only exercises the default 'regular' user_type; no test asserts an excluded type is actually threaded through.
findings.impact: A future regression at this call site (wrong attribute, hardcoded value) would silently defeat the exclusion feature for IDP email-resync reconciliation, and the existing test would not catch it.
findings.recommendation: Add a parametrized test (mirroring the site-5 reconcile test) that drives authenticate_persistent_user with user_type 'external'/'service_account' and asserts reconcile_personal_project_on_email_change is called with that value.

findings.title: Untested user_type pass-through in profile reconcile call
findings.problem: update_profile captures db_user.user_type and threads it into reconcile_personal_project_on_email_change (lines 202-204), but the sole existing test for this call site only exercises the default 'regular' user_type.
findings.impact: A future regression at this call site would silently defeat the exclusion feature for self-service email changes, and the existing test would not catch it.
findings.recommendation: Add a test constructing db_user with user_type 'external'/'service_account' and asserting reconcile_personal_project_on_email_change is invoked with that value.

finding_status.notes: New parametrized test (external/service_account) constructs db_user with the excluded user_type and idp_user with 'human'; verified _build_security_user maps security_user_ins.user_type from db_user, so the assertion on reconcile_personal_project_on_email_change proves the excluded value, not the IDP's 'human', is threaded through.

New parametrized test (external/service_account) sets db_user.user_type to the excluded value; source captures user_type before the update call, and the test asserts reconcile_personal_project_on_email_change receives that same excluded value, mirroring the existing regular-user test exactly.
